SPECIALISED SECURITY SUPPORT

Armed Escort Services

Security escort arrangements for approved movements of people, business assets and valuable consignments. Every request is assessed individually, with safety, lawful authority and prevention as priorities.

Request a ConsultationAll Services
SERVICE OVERVIEW

Planned. Responsible. Compliance-led.

Armed escort support is a specialised service and is not automatically available for every assignment. Any service must first meet all applicable legal, licensing, authorisation and client requirements in Papua New Guinea.

What the service may cover

  • Security escort support for authorised personnel and approved business movements.
  • Protective accompaniment for approved high-value goods or business assets.
  • Pre-assignment consultation to understand client security concerns and requirements.
  • Coordination and communication arrangements agreed with the client.
  • Incident reporting and post-assignment review, where included in the agreed scope.

Exact services, staffing, equipment and operating arrangements are determined only after a lawful assessment and written agreement.

Our service priorities

  • Protection of people and property.
  • Professional conduct and respect for the public.
  • Risk awareness and de-escalation.
  • Clear communication and accountability.
  • Compliance with relevant PNG laws and approvals.
Important: Firearms are not carried or used unless the company and assigned personnel hold every licence and authorisation required by law. No armed service is promised or deployed without verification of those requirements.
HOW TO ENGAGE

From enquiry to an agreed service

Each request follows a careful review before any service commitment is made.

01 / ENQUIRE

Discuss your needs

Tell us the general nature of the assignment, protection concerns and your preferred contact details.

02 / REVIEW

Assessment and checks

The request is reviewed for risk, feasibility, legal permissions, licensing and required approvals.

03 / AGREE

Written arrangements

If the request can lawfully be accepted, the scope, responsibilities and terms are confirmed before work begins.
